facts.business: Vishvprabha Ventures Limited is engaged in the engineering and construction of large infrastructure projects, with core business in civil construction projects and ready mix concrete.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: 1) expenses through imprest arrangements lacking adequate documentary evidence and approvals; 2) inventory records maintained through manual controls instead of ERP system; 3) Input Tax Credit availed on trade payables outstanding beyond 180 days requiring reversal; 4) non-consideration of Section 43B(h) of Income Tax Act for MSE dues; 5) non-recognition of gratuity liability per Ind AS 19; 6) failure to disclose sale/transfer of Residential TDR aggregating 76,096 sq meters amounting to Rs 10.26 crore as exempt supply in GST returns. Emphasis of matter: 1) irregular deposit of statutory dues including Income Tax Rs 12.73 lakhs, TDS Rs 2.75 lakhs, Professional Tax Rs 0.51 lakhs; 2) bank account with Bank of Maharashtra classified as NPA effective March 31, 2026; 3) loss on bad debts amounting to Rs 79.32 lakhs.
